newsitem.title: USA: Newmont Mining reports higher earnings.
newsitem.headline: Newmont Mining reports higher earnings.

text.p: Newmont Mining Corp., whose primary asset is its stake in Newmont Gold Co., the nation's biggest gold producer, Wednesday reported higher profits for the fourth quarter, thanks to a 12 percent jump in sales.

Newmont Gold said it earned $21.5 million in the fourth quarter compared with year earlier earnings of $4.6 million, while Newmont Mining earned $19.5 million vs. $4.1 million. The per share earnings, which reflect the results of both companies, were equal to 20 cents against earnings of 5 cents.
Sales increased to $206.5 million from $184.4 million.

For all of 1996, Newmont Gold earned $94.0 million, down from 1995 earnings of $124.9 million. Newmont Mining's income was $85.1 million, down from $112.7 million. Per share earnings fell to 86 cents from $1.17.
Sales increased to $768.5 million from $636.2 million.

Newmont said gold production increased 16 percent in the fourth quarter to 618,100 ounces compared with 534,700 ounces a year earlier. For the year, its gold production was up 23 percent to a record 2.28 million ounces from 1.86 million equity ounces in 1995.
The stock of Newmont Mining was off 62.5 cents at $40.25 and Newmont Gold slipped 50 cents at $40 on the New York Stock Exchange.
